reviews.review:
Gameplay & DifficultyStory & Narrative: The storyline is honestly trash. However, coming from someone who used to play Counter-Strike 1.6—which basically had zero story—the lack of a good plot doesn't bother me at all.Aggressive AI: The enemy AI is surprisingly accurate. Playing on Nightmare difficulty is genuinely brutal; you cannot upgrade character stats like health, armor, or speed. Your only progression is swapping weapons, and the AI is extremely aggressive. If you are a masochist who loves a hardcore challenge, you should definitely try Nightmare mode.Campaign & Stages: Stages 1 through 4 felt a bit forgettable, but the final stage is quite thrilling since it focuses on a massive boss battle.Defense Mode: The Defense mode works flawlessly and is completely doable. I even managed to reach Wave 37 on Stage 4.

Character Design & AestheticsVisuals & Physics: The character graphics are quite eye-catching, and I personally really like them. The character design and jiggle physics are great. The details are impressive; it's rare to see a game include an animated tail ornament that actually moves dynamically.Customization Disappointment: The costume variety is somewhat lacking. Sadly, the store tags are misleading—there is absolutely no nudity or explicit sexual content here.

Controls & Technical DetailsCamera & POV: Swapping between FPS and TPS modes is incredibly smooth. It even includes a shoulder-swap feature (left/right shoulder view), which is a rare and welcome addition not found in many games.Controls: You can fully rebind the controls to your liking. However, there is no aim assist for controllers, making gamepad gameplay highly discouraged. I strongly recommend playing with a keyboard and mouse instead.The Worst Part (Audio): The most annoying flaw is the sound design. Zombie and monster audio cues constantly trigger and sound close even when there are no enemies nearby.

Final VerdictIt's a huge shame that this game wasn't developed with more serious budget and backing, as it has a lot of potential. Worth a shot for casual shooter fans!
